resources.string: Where should DK64 keep its files?

Saves, settings, mods and your ROM can go in a shared \"%1$s\" folder on your device storage. You can reach it from a file manager or a PC to add mods, and it stays if you uninstall. This needs permission to access your files.\n\nOr keep everything in the app\'s own storage. No permission needed, but it\'s removed if you uninstall.
Turn on \"Allow access to manage all files\" for DK64, then come back.
No file access granted. Using app storage instead.
